name: Voxel Shadow Raycasting with DDA
definition: A GLSL implementation of a DDA (Digital Differential Analyzer) algorithm that traces rays from surface points to light sources to compute shadows in a voxel world. It uses a sparse or dense voxel buffer to determine light attenuation based on voxel density.
summary: Voxel Shadow Raycasting with DDA efficiently computes hard shadows in voxel scenes by using the Amanatides-Woo algorithm to traverse grid cells, avoiding slow fixed-step ray marching.
